answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Proof of unique mortgage payment history stops them at the door: payments made on one loan for five years, which means the willow of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Fakes fail here because payments made on one loan for five years is tied to something outside the network; the cipher of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The kernel is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
